resolution.note: krn-radar agent, roadmap line and tests shipped

title: Add a krn-radar subagent that turns the operator's RSS radar into roadmap candidates
body:
Outcome: `.claude/agents/krn-radar.md` reads the operator's rss-news CLI read-only and returns at most 300 words of KRN-applicable patterns with source URLs; the roadmap maintenance names it as an input of the proactive refill scan, while the rss_news MCP server stays denied for the lead.
Why: 2026-11-09 the operator asked for RSS news in KRN loaded only when needed. rss_news is denied in .claude/settings.json since b87beca (13 tools, ~10 kB schemas, multi-kB results in the lead's context). A manual radar run (krn-reader, `node bin/digest.js --hours 168 --top 120`, 117 items) returned one concrete pattern (secret scan of committed agent settings) at zero lead context beyond the verdict.
Proof: test/rules/project-skills.test.ts checks krn-radar has a model, maxTurns, no Edit/Write/Agent tools, and the roadmap names it; the rss_news denial stays.
Scope: .claude/agents/krn-radar.md, docs/program/roadmap.md, test/rules/project-skills.test.ts.
